create_expert_location_trivial: create an ExpertLocationMetadata with a trivial mapping where logical expert i maps to physical expert i
build_expert_location_by_mapping: build an ExpertLocationMetadata from a custom physical-to-logical expert mapping tensor
build_expert_location_by_eplb: build an ExpertLocationMetadata rebalanced using the EPLB algorithm based on token distribution
update_expert_location_layers: update specific layers of an ExpertLocationMetadata with mappings from another metadata instance
compute_initial_expert_location: compute initial ExpertLocationMetadata from server args, model config, and init strategy (trivial, mapping, or eplb)
